notes: Full base-game table asset, not just one sampled tree. The five independent forest canvases and private zones describe all players.
Exact root/card coordinates and occlusion relations describe variable forests; tree/clearing examples are not setup counts.
Alpine, Woodland Edge, Exploration, Dartmoor, and Smoky Mountains are excluded.
Card rule exceptions and version-dependent effect policy remain manual metadata; no rules engine or app integration is supplied.

structureEvidence.location: Official publisher game page and FAQ
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Original base game is 2–5 players; clearing, forest and cave card states are distinct; cave storage is produced by card effects.

structureEvidence.location: Official English base rulebook: all page text read; setup p.2 and card-attachment/scoring diagrams pp.4–5,7 directly inspected
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Complete component decomposition, all-player cave/hand setup, four-sided half-card tucking, face-down saplings, shared-slot examples, clearing/deck/winter/reference/scorepad table roles.
structureEvidence.access: local pinned PDF and direct rendered pages

structureEvidence.location: Official original base rules, card-attachment section
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: The four-side tucking and selected-visible-half structure are common to the original base release.

assetScope: Base Forest Shuffle whole-table asset and self-contained card-attachment JSON. Five independent forests, all private hands/caves, shared clearing/draw deck/winter row/reference cards/scorepad. App integration is separate.

tableModel.edition: Original European forest base game (2023); structural crosscheck with current official English base rules dated 2026-02-09. No expansions or standalone sequels.
tableModel.applicationIntegration: asset-only; current field names are optional mapping hints

coordinates.forestScene: unbounded per-player scene coordinates; a physical card is 100 by 150 scene units and the overview station is a pan/zoom viewport

componentInventory.countIdentity: 66+48+44+3+14+5=180; references and caves are included in 180 and are not part of the normal shuffled play-card deck

setup.winterDeckPreparation: After removing play cards, split the remaining deck into three similar piles. Two winter cards are shuffled into the bottom pile and the third is placed atop that bottom pile. Preserve the hidden sequence, never expose it to players.
setup.currentRulesDifference: The official product FAQ removes the old no-tree starting-hand mulligan. This asset does not execute setup or effects, and does not silently migrate rule-edition choices.

cardAssembly.cropCoordinates: visibleCrop is in the attached card’s own [0,0,100,150] coordinates; fullCardBox is relative to the tree root. Tree layer covers the unused half.
cardAssembly.sameSideMultipleCards: Store a side as a list, never cap it at one. Preserve the actual x/y/layer and tuckedUnderCardId chain; some printed card effects permit sharing. A generic renderer must not invent legality or remove observed cards.
cardAssembly.inactiveHalf: The occluded half is not a second played inhabitant. Do not score/count it or replace the physical card with two independent cards.
cardAssembly.forestLayout: No fixed maximum tree count, grid or adjacency path. Roots have independent scene coordinates; attachments move with their root while maintaining local coordinates. Pan/zoom an expanded bounding box when needed.

public: forest roots and exposed selected halves
owner: cave stored identities/count mapped to current owner scope
hidden: sapling face hidden by its back

visualZones.role: hidden deck, shared reference cards, scorepad and 0–3 revealed winters

tableModel.unknownPolicy: Preserve unknown card/half/attribute facts and actual observed overlays. Do not infer hidden halves, reorder the deck, count the sapling’s hidden printed tree type or turn example cards into real state.
tableModel.ruleAutomation: No card-specific legality, cost/effect/bonus execution, cleanup, scoring or game-end automation; retain pending action flags so a later consumer can resume without double application.

completeStructures: all five forests with tree/sapling and four-side attachment syntax
all five private hands and cave storage piles
shared long clearing with deck to its left
variable forest geometry, selected visible half and occlusion graph
diagramOnly: two card-assembly examples per forest are not an initial tree count
three clearing cards and winter placeholders are not revealed state
notAutomated: clearing cleanup, draw replacement and winter end trigger

auxiliaryAssets.purpose: Original blank example: four correctly tucked half-card directions, a same-side card chain, and a face-down sapling. Not an initial game state.
